name: Ajax NxNxN 2022

venue.name: [Ajax Community Centre - HMS Community Hall](https://facilities.ajax.ca/Home/Detail?Id=db52c417-b7aa-40fe-8939-61304512694f)
venue.details: The HMS Community Hall is on the main floor of the community centre

information: This is a competition in a series with [Ajax First-Timers 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxFirstTimers2022). You will only be able to register for *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. This competition is not recommeded for new competitors. If you are a new competitor, we recommend registering for [Ajax First-Timers 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxFirstTimers2022). **Reminder:** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. We expect that registration will fill up fast, so please plan to be ready as soon as registration opens!
